Policy-ID: TRACKER-MIGRATION-V2
Status: ACTIVE

For Jira sources, publish to Linear team OPS, project Reliability. Map Jira Highest/High/Medium to Linear 1/2/3. Preserve source summary and full description and append a blank line and Migration source: <source-identifier>. If that provenance already exists, repair the same target in place and never create a duplicate. Provider 5xx responses before commit are retryable. After confirmation, add exactly Migrated to <target-identifier>. to the source. Never close the source or modify code.
